integrationsDesc: Connect the tools your AI employees need to do their jobs.
customIntegrationDesc: Build a custom API connection for your internal tools.

n8nConnection.title: Your n8n Instances
n8nConnection.subtitle: Connect your own n8n instance (your domain + API key). Keys are encrypted at rest — only …last4 is ever shown.
n8nConnection.howItWorks: How it works: Jaafar designs an Automation → you Approve & Provision → the workflow is created + activated in your n8n. Inbound Gateway: import docs/workflows/inbound_channel_workflow.json into your n8n.
n8nConnection.connectDesc: Your API key is encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again.
n8nConnection.name: Name
n8nConnection.baseUrlHint: Must be a reachable URL. Private network addresses are blocked for security.
n8nConnection.httpWarning: Production accepts HTTPS only — use https://your-domain.com
n8nConnection.apiKeyHint: In n8n: Settings → n8n API → Create API key (self-hosted requires the Public API to be enabled).
n8nConnection.editDesc: Leave API key empty to keep the current one.
n8nConnection.emptyDesc: Connect your n8n instance to enable Automations. Your workflows stay in your infrastructure — we only provision what you approve.
n8nConnection.suspendDesc: Automations using it will be unavailable until you resume the connection.
n8nConnection.removeDesc: Automations using it will be suspended until you reconnect or reprovision. The stored key will be deleted.
n8nConnection.validateUrl: Base URL must be a valid URL (https://your-n8n.example.com).
n8nConnection.validateKeyEdit: API key must be 8+ chars if provided.

errorMap.keyRejected: API key rejected — generate a new key in n8n → Settings → n8n API.
errorMap.unreachable: We couldn't reach your n8n domain — check the URL and that your instance is running.
errorMap.dns: We couldn't resolve that domain — check for typos.
errorMap.blocked: Blocked for security: private network addresses and plain HTTP (outside development) are not allowed.
errorMap.apiError: Your n8n API returned an error.
